response.sql: SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 as region, SUM(t.amount) as total_amount, COUNT(*) as transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans) as fraction FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3 ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Include undocumented VYBER transactions (16,666 rows with unstated direction) in the absolute sum, since the request does not exclude them and they exist in the data

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude undocumented VYBER transactions; sum only documented transaction types (PRIJEM and VYDAJ)
alternatives.sql: SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 as region, SUM(t.amount) as total_amount, COUNT(*) as transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')) as fraction FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3 ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10;

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate net transaction impact by direction (PRIJEM adds, VYDAJ subtracts), excluding VYBER as ambiguous
alternatives.sql: SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 as region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) as net_amount, COUNT(*) as transaction_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) FROM trans WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')) as fraction FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3 ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10;
